title: Prepare exhaustive easy-school component annotation packet
description: Materialize ZeroCoolHacker/easy-school at pinned commit 69ad989f7930d77d54145aae422cc2a7cb4c4dd2. Confirm license suitability. Define a manageable complete-file or complete-directory component scope, inventory every source file inside it, and record every exclusion with a reason. Prepare human-review records for every scanner-relevant component declaration in scope, including positive, valuable negative, and ambiguous cases with stable subject identity, exact evidence, proposed labels, rationale, and proposed provenance. Do not show current scanner output during initial packet preparation and do not mark any annotation accepted. Verify all evidence against the pinned checkout.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Curation verification found the pinned easy-school LICENSE is the GLWT Good Luck With That Public License. It permits broad use but contains an unusual no-trace condition, so it is not suitable for durable benchmark use without an explicit authorized legal decision. Do not prepare or accept further easy-school ground truth. The first packet moves to Apache-2.0-licensed Hyperswitch Card Vault; Gitea is the next MIT-licensed packet.
